chapters.html:
2 John 1

1. The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;

2. for the truth's sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

3. Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Cosmic Parent, and from Master Yeshua the Messiah, the Son of the Cosmic Parent, in truth and love.

4. I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Cosmic Parent.

5. Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

6. This is love, that we should walk according to God's commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

7. For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don't confess that Yeshua the Messiah came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

8. Watch yourselves, that we don't lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

9. Whoever transgresses and doesn't remain in the teaching of Messiah, doesn't have God. The one who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Cosmic Parent and the Son.

10. If anyone comes to you, and doesn't bring this teaching, don't receive them into your house, and don't welcome them,

11. for the one who welcomes them participates in their works of unripeness.

12. Having many things to write to you, I don't want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

13. The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
